page.notes: Right printed page only; the left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted. The printed text is a continuous paragraph from "Octavo" to the foot. Doubtful readings: "laesit" (line 4), "repostulauit" (line 24). The catchword and signature are read from the foot of the page. The large initial O of "Octavo" is joined to its word.
